name: Default
shortDescription: Portabase dashboard for scheduling, storing and restoring database backups through agents, with a dedicated PostgreSQL database.

alerts.message: The first account registered on the dashboard becomes the super admin. Register it right after deployment and finish the onboarding wizard.
Backups run through Portabase agents installed next to the databases you protect. Create an agent in the dashboard and deploy it with the edge key it gives you.
